prediction_before_run: At base pose (0,0,0), front range is 1.049 m to box_front; left is 2.5 m, back is 2.951 m, right is 2.5 m.
At base yaw +90 deg, the local front points toward world +Y and range becomes 2.549 m because the sensor offset rotates with the base.
The first visible surface occludes surfaces behind it. Robot and child wheel geometry must not appear as returns.
All ideal rays should agree with independent box/cylinder/plane intersections within 1e-8 m; no-return and too-close status must also agree.
parameter_basis: Project-selected ideal scanner: 360 beams, 1 deg spacing, 0.05-4 m range, 10 Hz instantaneous scans; not hardware calibration or a named LiDAR specification.
noise: None; no dropout, intensity, rolling scan timing or motion distortion.
truth_boundary: Sensor generation uses simulator site transforms internally. Public scan contains only time, frame, angles, ranges and status; world pose and geom IDs are separate evaluation diagnostics.
